sections.label: Nāmāni
sections.note: The thousand names, in a hundred and eighty-three stanzas. Ten stanzas to a group, each group its own recording.

verses.devanagari: श्री माता श्री महाराज्ञी श्रीमत्सिंहासनेश्वरी । चिदग्नि कुण्डसम्भूता देवकार्यसमुद्यता ॥ १ ॥
verses.iast: śrī mātā, śrī mahārājñī, śrīmat-siṃhāsanēśvarī । chidagni kuṇḍasambhūtā, dēvakāryasamudyatā ॥ 1 ॥
verses.meaning: The Divine Mother; the Great Empress; Queen of the glorious lion-throne; Born from the fire-pit of pure consciousness; intent on carrying out the work of the gods.

verses.devanagari: उद्यद्भानु सहस्राभा चतुर्बाहु समन्विता । रागस्वरूप पाशाढ्या क्रोधाकाराङ्कुशोज्ज्वला ॥ २ ॥
verses.iast: udyadbhānu sahasrābhā, chaturbāhu samanvitā । rāgasvarūpa pāśāḍhyā, krōdhākārāṅkuśōjjvalā ॥ 2 ॥
verses.meaning: Radiant as a thousand rising suns; endowed with four arms; Holding the noose that is desire (attachment); shining with the goad that is anger;

verses.devanagari: मनोरूपेक्षुकोदण्डा पञ्चतन्मात्र सायका । निजारुण प्रभापूर मज्जद्ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ ३ ॥
verses.iast: manōrūpēkṣukōdaṇḍā, pañchatanmātra sāyakā । nijāruṇa prabhāpūra majjad-brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā ॥ 3 ॥
verses.meaning: Holding the sugarcane bow that is the mind; whose arrows are the five subtle elements (tanmatras); Who submerges the whole universe in the flood of her own rosy-red radiance.

verses.devanagari: चम्पकाशोक पुन्नाग सौगन्धिक लसत्कचा । कुरुविन्द मणिश्रेणी कनत्कोटीर मण्डिता ॥ ४ ॥
verses.iast: champakāśōka punnāga saugandhika lasatkachā kuruvinda maṇiśrēṇī kanatkōṭīra maṇḍitā ॥ 4 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose shining hair is adorned with champaka, ashoka, punnaga and saugandhika flowers; Adorned with a crown sparkling with rows of kuruvinda gems (rubies).

verses.devanagari: अष्टमी चन्द्र विभ्राज दळिकस्थल शोभिता । मुखचन्द्र कळङ्काभ म्ड़्गनाभि विशेषका ॥ ५ ॥
verses.iast: aṣṭamī chandra vibhrāja daḻikasthala śōbhitā । mukhachandra kaḻaṅkābha mṛganābhi viśēṣakā ॥ 5 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose forehead shines like the moon of the eighth lunar day (the half moon); Whose musk tilaka on her moon-like face looks like the mark on the moon.

verses.devanagari: वदनस्मर माङ्गल्य ग्ढ़तोरण चिल्लिका । वक्त्रलक्ष्मी परीवाह चलन्मीनाभ लोचना ॥ ६ ॥
verses.iast: vadanasmara māṅgalya gṛhatōraṇa chillikā । vaktralakṣmī parīvāha chalanmīnābha lōchanā ॥ 6 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose eyebrows are like the arched gateway to the house of Kama, which is her face; Whose eyes are like fish darting in the stream of beauty flowing from her face.

verses.devanagari: नवचम्पक पुष्पाभ नासादण्ड विराजिता । ताराकान्ति तिरस्कारि नासाभरण भासुरा ॥ ७ ॥
verses.iast: navachampaka puṣpābha nāsādaṇḍa virājitā । tārākānti tiraskāri nāsābharaṇa bhāsurā ॥ 7 ॥
verses.meaning: Graced with a nose like a freshly opened champaka flower; Radiant with a nose-ornament that outshines the brilliance of the stars.

verses.devanagari: कदम्ब मञ्जरीकॢप्त कर्णपूर मनोहरा । ताटङ्क युगळीभूत तपनोडुप मण्डला ॥ ८ ॥
verses.iast: kadamba mañjarīkḷpta karṇapūra manōharā । tāṭaṅka yugaḻībhūta tapanōḍupa maṇḍalā ॥ 8 ॥
verses.meaning: Charming with ear-ornaments made of clusters of kadamba flowers; Who wears the sun and the moon as her pair of earrings.

verses.devanagari: पद्मराग शिलादर्श परिभावि कपोलभूः । नवविद्रुम बिम्बश्रीः न्यक्कारि रदनच्छदा ॥ ९ ॥
verses.iast: padmarāga śilādarśa paribhāvi kapōlabhūḥ । navavidruma bimbaśrīḥ nyakkāri radanachChadā ॥ 9 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose cheeks outshine mirrors of polished ruby; Whose lips surpass the beauty of fresh coral and the bimba fruit.

verses.devanagari: शुद्ध विद्याङ्कुराकार द्विजपङ्क्ति द्वयोज्ज्वला । कर्पूरवीटि कामोद समाकर्षद्दिगन्तरा ॥ १० ॥
verses.iast: śuddha vidyāṅkurākāra dvijapaṅkti dvayōjjvalā । karpūravīṭi kāmōda samākarṣaddigantarā ॥ 10 ॥
verses.meaning: Shining with two rows of teeth like the sprouting buds of pure knowledge (Shuddha Vidya); Whose camphor-scented betel draws in the fragrance of every direction.

verses.devanagari: निजसल्लाप माधुर्य विनिर्भत्सित कच्छपी । मन्दस्मित प्रभापूर मज्जत्कामेश मानसा ॥ ११ ॥
verses.iast: nijasallāpa mādhurya vinirbhatsita kachChapī । mandasmita prabhāpūra majjat-kāmēśa mānasā ॥ 11 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose sweet speech puts to shame the veena (kacchapi) of Sarasvati; Who submerges the mind of Kameshvara in the radiance of her gentle smile.

verses.devanagari: अनाकलित साद्ड़्श्य चुबुक श्री विराजिता । कामेशबद्ध माङ्गल्य सूत्रशोभित कन्थरा ॥ १२ ॥
verses.iast: anākalita sādṛśya chubuka śrī virājitā । kāmēśabaddha māṅgalya sūtraśōbhita kantharā ॥ 12 ॥
verses.meaning: Graced with a chin of incomparable beauty; Whose neck is adorned with the marriage thread tied by Kameshvara.

verses.devanagari: कनकाङ्गद केयूर कमनीय भुजान्विता । रत्नग्रैवेय चिन्ताक लोलमुक्ता फलान्विता ॥ १३ ॥
verses.iast: kanakāṅgada kēyūra kamanīya bhujānvitā । ratnagraivēya chintāka lōlamuktā phalānvitā ॥ 13 ॥
verses.meaning: With lovely arms adorned with golden armlets and bracelets; Wearing a jewelled necklace with a pendant and swinging pearls.

verses.devanagari: कामेश्वर प्रेमरत्न मणि प्रतिपणस्तनी । नाभ्यालवाल रोमाळि लताफल कुचद्वयी ॥ १४ ॥
verses.iast: kāmēśvara prēmaratna maṇi pratipaṇastanī। nābhyālavāla rōmāḻi latāphala kuchadvayī ॥ 14 ॥
verses.meaning: Who gives her breasts in exchange for the precious gem of Kameshvara's love; Whose breasts are like the fruits of the creeper of fine hair rising from the basin of her navel.

verses.devanagari: लक्ष्यरोमलता धारता समुन्नेय मध्यमा । स्तनभार दळन्मध्य पट्टबन्ध वळित्रया ॥ १५ ॥
verses.iast: lakṣyarōmalatā dhāratā samunnēya madhyamā । stanabhāra daḻan-madhya paṭṭabandha vaḻitrayā ॥ 15 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose waist is so slender that it can only be inferred from the creeper of fine hair; Whose waist, strained by the weight of her breasts, bears three folds like a binding belt.

verses.devanagari: अरुणारुण कौसुम्भ वस्त्र भास्वत्कटीतटी । रत्नकिङ्किणि कारम्य रशनादाम भूषिता ॥ १६ ॥
verses.iast: aruṇāruṇa kausumbha vastra bhāsvat-kaṭītaṭī । ratnakiṅkiṇi kāramya raśanādāma bhūṣitā ॥ 16 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose hips shine in a garment dyed deep red with safflower; Adorned with a girdle made charming by jewelled bells.

verses.devanagari: कामेश ज्ञात सौभाग्य मार्दवोरु द्वयान्विता । माणिक्य मकुटाकार जानुद्वय विराजिता ॥ १७ ॥
verses.iast: kāmēśa jñāta saubhāgya mārdavōru dvayānvitā । māṇikya makuṭākāra jānudvaya virājitā ॥ 17 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose thighs, in their beauty and softness, are known only to Kamesha; Whose knees shine like crowns carved from rubies.

verses.devanagari: इन्द्रगोप परिक्षिप्त स्मर तूणाभ जङ्घिका । गूढगुल्भा कूर्मप्ड़्ष्ठ जयिष्णु प्रपदान्विता ॥ १८ ॥
verses.iast: indragōpa parikṣipta smara tūṇābha jaṅghikā । gūḍhagulbhā kūrmapṛṣṭha jayiṣṇu prapadānvitā ॥ 18 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose calves are like Kama's quiver, decorated with red indragopa insects; With hidden ankles, and feet whose arches surpass the curve of a tortoise's back.

verses.devanagari: नखदीधिति सञ्छन्न नमज्जन तमोगुणा । पदद्वय प्रभाजाल पराक्ड़्त सरोरुहा ॥ १९ ॥
verses.iast: nakhadīdhiti sañChanna namajjana tamōguṇā । padadvaya prabhājāla parākṛta sarōruhā ॥ 19 ॥
verses.meaning: The radiance of whose toenails dispels the darkness of ignorance in those who bow to her; Whose two feet outshine the lotuses in brilliance.

verses.devanagari: शिञ्जान मणिमञ्जीर मण्डित श्री पदाम्बुजा । मराळी मन्दगमना महालावण्य शेवधिः ॥ २० ॥
verses.iast: śiñjāna maṇimañjīra maṇḍita śrī padāmbujā । marāḻī mandagamanā, mahālāvaṇya śēvadhiḥ ॥ 20 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose lovely lotus feet are adorned with tinkling jewelled anklets; Who walks slowly and gracefully like a swan; the treasure-house of supreme beauty.

verses.devanagari: सर्वारुणाऽनवद्याङ्गी सर्वाभरण भूषिता । शिवकामेश्वराङ्कस्था शिवा स्वाधीन वल्लभा ॥ २१ ॥
verses.iast: sarvāruṇā'navadyāṅgī sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitā । śivakāmēśvarāṅkasthā, śivā, svādhīna vallabhā ॥ 21 ॥
verses.meaning: Red in every way; flawless in every limb; adorned with all ornaments; Seated on the lap of Shiva-Kameshvara; the Auspicious One (Shiva); who holds her beloved under her sway.

verses.devanagari: सुमेरु मध्यश्ड़्ङ्गस्था श्रीमन्नगर नायिका । चिन्तामणि ग्ढ़ान्तस्था पञ्चब्रह्मासनस्थिता ॥ २२ ॥
verses.iast: sumēru madhyaśṛṅgasthā, śrīmannagara nāyikā । chintāmaṇi gṛhāntasthā, pañchabrahmāsanasthitā ॥ 22 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling on the central peak of Mount Meru; Queen of the glorious city (Srinagara); Dwelling in the mansion of wish-fulfilling gems (Chintamani); seated on the throne of the five Brahmas.

verses.devanagari: महापद्माटवी संस्था कदम्ब वनवासिनी । सुधासागर मध्यस्था कामाक्षी कामदायिनी ॥ २३ ॥
verses.iast: mahāpadmāṭavī saṃsthā, kadamba vanavāsinī । sudhāsāgara madhyasthā, kāmākṣī kāmadāyinī ॥ 23 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the great forest of lotuses; residing in the kadamba grove; Abiding in the middle of the ocean of nectar; the one with loving eyes (Kamakshi); the giver of desires.

verses.devanagari: देवर्षि गणसङ्घात स्तूयमानात्म वैभवा । भण्डासुर वधोद्युक्त शक्तिसेना समन्विता ॥ २४ ॥
verses.iast: dēvarṣi gaṇasaṅghāta stūyamānātma vaibhavā । bhaṇḍāsura vadhōdyukta śaktisēnā samanvitā ॥ 24 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose glory is praised by hosts of gods and sages; Accompanied by an army of Shaktis ready to slay the demon Bhanda.

verses.devanagari: सम्पत्करी समारूढ सिन्धुर व्रजसेविता । अश्वारूढाधिष्ठिताश्व कोटिकोटि भिराव्ड़्ता ॥ २५ ॥
verses.iast: sampatkarī samārūḍha sindhura vrajasēvitā । aśvārūḍhādhiṣṭhitāśva kōṭikōṭi bhirāvṛtā ॥ 25 ॥
verses.meaning: Attended by herds of elephants led by Sampatkari; Surrounded by countless crores of horses commanded by Ashvarudha.

verses.devanagari: चक्रराज रथारूढ सर्वायुध परिष्क्ड़्ता । गेयचक्र रथारूढ मन्त्रिणी परिसेविता ॥ २६ ॥
verses.iast: chakrarāja rathārūḍha sarvāyudha pariṣkṛtā । gēyachakra rathārūḍha mantriṇī parisēvitā ॥ 26 ॥
verses.meaning: Riding the chariot Chakraraja, equipped with every weapon; Served by Mantrini (Shyamala), who rides the chariot Geyachakra.

verses.devanagari: किरिचक्र रथारूढ दण्डनाथा पुरस्क्ड़्ता । ज्वालामालिनि काक्षिप्त वह्निप्राकार मध्यगा ॥ २७ ॥
verses.iast: kirichakra rathārūḍha daṇḍanāthā puraskṛtā । jvālāmālini kākṣipta vahniprākāra madhyagā ॥ 27 ॥
verses.meaning: Escorted by Dandanatha (Varahi), who rides the chariot Kirichakra; Stationed in the middle of the fortress of fire raised by Jvalamalini.

verses.devanagari: भण्डसैन्य वधोद्युक्त शक्ति विक्रमहर्षिता । नित्या पराक्रमाटोप निरीक्षण समुत्सुका ॥ २८ ॥
verses.iast: bhaṇḍasainya vadhōdyukta śakti vikramaharṣitā । nityā parākramāṭōpa nirīkṣaṇa samutsukā ॥ 28 ॥
verses.meaning: Delighted by the valour of the Shaktis set on destroying Bhanda's army; Eager to watch the might and prowess of the Nitya goddesses.

verses.devanagari: भण्डपुत्र वधोद्युक्त बालाविक्रम नन्दिता । मन्त्रिण्यम्बा विरचित विषङ्ग वधतोषिता ॥ २९ ॥
verses.iast: bhaṇḍaputra vadhōdyukta bālāvikrama nanditā । mantriṇyambā virachita viṣaṅga vadhatōṣitā ॥ 29 ॥
verses.meaning: Pleased by the valour of Bala, intent on slaying the sons of Bhanda; Gratified by Mantrini's slaying of the demon Vishanga.

verses.devanagari: विशुक्र प्राणहरण वाराही वीर्यनन्दिता । कामेश्वर मुखालोक कल्पित श्री गणेश्वरा ॥ ३० ॥
verses.iast: viśukra prāṇaharaṇa vārāhī vīryananditā । kāmēśvara mukhālōka kalpita śrī gaṇēśvarā ॥ 30 ॥
verses.meaning: Delighted by the valour of Varahi, who took the life of Vishukra; Who brought forth Ganesha by a glance at the face of Kameshvara.

verses.devanagari: महागणेश निर्भिन्न विघ्नयन्त्र प्रहर्षिता । भण्डासुरेन्द्र निर्मुक्त शस्त्र प्रत्यस्त्र वर्षिणी ॥ ३१ ॥
verses.iast: mahāgaṇēśa nirbhinna vighnayantra praharṣitā । bhaṇḍāsurēndra nirmukta śastra pratyastra varṣiṇī ॥ 31 ॥
verses.meaning: Rejoicing when Mahaganesha shattered the obstacle-yantra (Vighna-yantra); Who showered counter-weapons against every weapon hurled by Bhandasura.

verses.devanagari: कराङ्गुळि नखोत्पन्न नारायण दशाक्ड़्तिः । महापाशुपतास्त्राग्नि निर्दग्धासुर सैनिका ॥ ३२ ॥
verses.iast: karāṅguḻi nakhōtpanna nārāyaṇa daśākṛtiḥ । mahāpāśupatāstrāgni nirdagdhāsura sainikā ॥ 32 ॥
verses.meaning: Who created the ten incarnations of Narayana from her fingernails; Who burnt the demon armies with the fire of the Mahapashupata missile.

verses.devanagari: कामेश्वरास्त्र निर्दग्ध सभण्डासुर शून्यका । ब्रह्मोपेन्द्र महेन्द्रादि देवसंस्तुत वैभवा ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.iast: kāmēśvarāstra nirdagdha sabhaṇḍāsura śūnyakā । brahmōpēndra mahēndrādi dēvasaṃstuta vaibhavā ॥ 33 ॥
verses.meaning: Who burnt Bhandasura and his city Shunyaka with the Kameshvara missile; Whose glory is praised by Brahma, Vishnu, Indra and the other gods.

verses.devanagari: हरनेत्राग्नि सन्दग्ध काम सञ्जीवनौषधिः । श्रीमद्वाग्भव कूटैक स्वरूप मुखपङ्कजा ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.iast: haranētrāgni sandagdha kāma sañjīvanauṣadhiḥ । śrīmadvāgbhava kūṭaika svarūpa mukhapaṅkajā ॥ 34 ॥
verses.meaning: The life-giving herb that revived Kama, who had been burnt by the fire of Shiva's eye; Whose lotus face is the Vagbhava-kuta, the first section of the Panchadashi mantra.

verses.devanagari: कण्ठाधः कटिपर्यन्त मध्यकूट स्वरूपिणी । शक्तिकूटैक तापन्न कट्यथोभाग धारिणी ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.iast: kaṇṭhādhaḥ kaṭiparyanta madhyakūṭa svarūpiṇī । śaktikūṭaika tāpanna kaṭyathōbhāga dhāriṇī ॥ 35 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose body from the neck to the waist is the middle section (Kamaraja-kuta); Whose body below the waist is the Shakti-kuta.

verses.devanagari: मूलमन्त्रात्मिका मूलकूट त्रय कळेबरा । कुळाम्ड़्तैक रसिका कुळसङ्केत पालिनी ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.iast: mūlamantrātmikā, mūlakūṭa traya kaḻēbarā । kuḻāmṛtaika rasikā, kuḻasaṅkēta pālinī ॥ 36 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose very self is the root mantra (Mula-mantra); whose body is its three sections; Who delights in the nectar of Kula; protector of the secret conventions of Kula.

verses.devanagari: कुळाङ्गना कुळान्तःस्था कौळिनी कुळयोगिनी । अकुळा समयान्तःस्था समयाचार तत्परा ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.iast: kuḻāṅganā, kuḻāntaḥsthā, kauḻinī, kuḻayōginī । akuḻā, samayāntaḥsthā, samayāchāra tatparā ॥ 37 ॥
verses.meaning: The lady of the Kula tradition; dwelling within Kula; the Kaulini; the Kula-yogini; Beyond Kula (Akula); dwelling within Samaya; devoted to the Samaya way of worship.

verses.devanagari: मूलाधारैक निलया ब्रह्मग्रन्थि विभेदिनी । मणिपूरान्त रुदिता विष्णुग्रन्थि विभेदिनी ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.iast: mūlādhāraika nilayā, brahmagranthi vibhēdinī । maṇipūrānta ruditā, viṣṇugranthi vibhēdinī ॥ 38 ॥
verses.meaning: Residing in the Muladhara; who pierces the knot of Brahma; Who rises up in the Manipura; who pierces the knot of Vishnu;

verses.devanagari: आज्ञा चक्रान्तराळस्था रुद्रग्रन्थि विभेदिनी । सहस्राराम्बुजा रूढा सुधासाराभि वर्षिणी ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.iast: ājñā chakrāntarāḻasthā, rudragranthi vibhēdinī । sahasrārāmbujā rūḍhā, sudhāsārābhi varṣiṇī ॥ 39 ॥
verses.meaning: Abiding in the Ajna chakra; who pierces the knot of Rudra; Ascending to the thousand-petalled lotus (Sahasrara); who showers streams of nectar.

verses.devanagari: तटिल्लता समरुचिः षट्चक्रोपरि संस्थिता । महाशक्तिः कुण्डलिनी बिसतन्तु तनीयसी ॥ ४० ॥
verses.iast: taṭillatā samaruchiḥ, ṣaṭ-chakrōpari saṃsthitā । mahāśaktiḥ, kuṇḍalinī, bisatantu tanīyasī ॥ 40 ॥
verses.meaning: Brilliant as a streak of lightning; established above the six chakras; The Great Power; Kundalini; as fine as a fibre of the lotus stalk.

verses.devanagari: भवानी भावनागम्या भवारण्य कुठारिका । भद्रप्रिया भद्रमूर्ति र्भक्तसौभाग्य दायिनी ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.iast: bhavānī, bhāvanāgamyā, bhavāraṇya kuṭhārikā । bhadrapriyā, bhadramūrti, rbhaktasaubhāgya dāyinī ॥ 41 ॥
verses.meaning: Bhavani (consort of Shiva); reached through contemplation; the axe that clears the forest of worldly existence; Fond of what is auspicious; of auspicious form; giver of good fortune to devotees.

verses.devanagari: भक्तिप्रिया भक्तिगम्या भक्तिवश्या भयापहा । शाम्भवी शारदाराध्या शर्वाणी शर्मदायिनी ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.iast: bhaktipriyā, bhaktigamyā, bhaktivaśyā, bhayāpahā । śāmbhavī, śāradārādhyā, śarvāṇī, śarmadāyinī ॥ 42 ॥
verses.meaning: Who loves devotion; reached through devotion; won over by devotion; remover of fear; Consort of Shambhu; worshipped by Sharada (Sarasvati); consort of Sharva; giver of happiness.

verses.devanagari: शाङ्करी श्रीकरी साध्वी शरच्चन्द्रनिभानना । शातोदरी शान्तिमती निराधारा निरञ्जना ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.iast: śāṅkarī, śrīkarī, sādhvī, śarachchandranibhānanā । śātōdarī, śāntimatī, nirādhārā, nirañjanā ॥ 43 ॥
verses.meaning: Consort of Shankara; giver of prosperity; the chaste one; whose face is like the autumn moon; Slender-waisted; full of peace; needing no support; spotless.

verses.devanagari: निर्लेपा निर्मला नित्या निराकारा निराकुला । निर्गुणा निष्कळा शान्ता निष्कामा निरुपप्लवा ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.iast: nirlēpā, nirmalā, nityā, nirākārā, nirākulā । nirguṇā, niṣkaḻā, śāntā, niṣkāmā, nirupaplavā ॥ 44 ॥
verses.meaning: Untainted; pure; eternal; formless; undisturbed; Beyond the gunas; without parts; serene; desireless; indestructible.

verses.devanagari: नित्यमुक्ता निर्विकारा निष्प्रपञ्चा निराश्रया । नित्यशुद्धा नित्यबुद्धा निरवद्या निरन्तरा ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.iast: nityamuktā, nirvikārā, niṣprapañchā, nirāśrayā । nityaśuddhā, nityabuddhā, niravadyā, nirantarā ॥ 45 ॥
verses.meaning: Eternally free; changeless; beyond the manifest world; depending on nothing; Eternally pure; eternally awakened; blameless; ever-present everywhere.

verses.devanagari: निष्कारणा निष्कळङ्का निरुपाधि र्निरीश्वरा । नीरागा रागमथनी निर्मदा मदनाशिनी ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.iast: niṣkāraṇā, niṣkaḻaṅkā, nirupādhi, rnirīśvarā । nīrāgā, rāgamathanī, nirmadā, madanāśinī ॥ 46 ॥
verses.meaning: Without cause; stainless; free of limiting conditions; with no lord above her; Free of passion; destroyer of passion; free of pride; destroyer of pride.

verses.devanagari: निश्चिन्ता निरहङ्कारा निर्मोहा मोहनाशिनी । निर्ममा ममताहन्त्री निष्पापा पापनाशिनी ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.iast: niśchintā, nirahaṅkārā, nirmōhā, mōhanāśinī । nirmamā, mamatāhantrī, niṣpāpā, pāpanāśinī ॥ 47 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of worry; free of ego; free of delusion; destroyer of delusion; Free of possessiveness; slayer of possessiveness; sinless; destroyer of sin.

verses.devanagari: निष्क्रोधा क्रोधशमनी निर्लोभा लोभनाशिनी । निःसंशया संशयघ्नी निर्भवा भवनाशिनी ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.iast: niṣkrōdhā, krōdhaśamanī, nirlōbhā, lōbhanāśinī । niḥsaṃśayā, saṃśayaghnī, nirbhavā, bhavanāśinī ॥ 48 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of anger; queller of anger; free of greed; destroyer of greed; Free of doubt; slayer of doubt; unborn; destroyer of the cycle of birth.

verses.devanagari: निर्विकल्पा निराबाधा निर्भेदा भेदनाशिनी । निर्नाशा म्ड़्त्युमथनी निष्क्रिया निष्परिग्रहा ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.iast: nirvikalpā, nirābādhā, nirbhēdā, bhēdanāśinī । nirnāśā, mṛtyumathanī, niṣkriyā, niṣparigrahā ॥ 49 ॥
verses.meaning: Beyond all mental modifications; unobstructed; free of difference; destroyer of the sense of difference; Imperishable; conqueror of death; actionless; possessing nothing.

verses.devanagari: निस्तुला नीलचिकुरा निरपाया निरत्यया । दुर्लभा दुर्गमा दुर्गा दुःखहन्त्री सुखप्रदा ॥ ५० ॥
verses.iast: nistulā, nīlachikurā, nirapāyā, niratyayā । durlabhā, durgamā, durgā, duḥkhahantrī, sukhapradā ॥ 50 ॥
verses.meaning: Incomparable; with dark-blue hair; free of decline; never surpassed; Hard to attain; hard to approach; Durga; destroyer of sorrow; giver of happiness.

verses.devanagari: दुष्टदूरा दुराचार शमनी दोषवर्जिता । सर्वज्ञा सान्द्रकरुणा समानाधिकवर्जिता ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.iast: duṣṭadūrā, durāchāra śamanī, dōṣavarjitā । sarvajñā, sāndrakaruṇā, samānādhikavarjitā ॥ 51 ॥
verses.meaning: Far from the wicked; queller of evil conduct; free of faults; All-knowing; full of deep compassion; having no equal or superior.

verses.devanagari: सर्वशक्तिमयी सर्वमङ्गळा सद्गतिप्रदा । सर्वेश्वरी सर्वमयी सर्वमन्त्र स्वरूपिणी ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.iast: sarvaśaktimayī, sarvamaṅgaḻā, sadgatipradā । sarvēśvarī, sarvamayī, sarvamantra svarūpiṇī ॥ 52 ॥
verses.meaning: Possessing all powers; the auspiciousness of all; giver of the good path (liberation); Ruler of all; pervading all; embodiment of all mantras.

verses.devanagari: सर्वयन्त्रात्मिका सर्वतन्त्ररूपा मनोन्मनी । माहेश्वरी महादेवी महालक्ष्मी र्म्ड़्डप्रिया ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.iast: sarvayantrātmikā, sarvatantrarūpā, manōnmanī । māhēśvarī, mahādēvī, mahālakṣmī, rmṛḍapriyā ॥ 53 ॥
verses.meaning: Essence of all yantras; embodiment of all tantras; beyond the mind (Manonmani); Consort of Maheshvara; the Great Goddess; Mahalakshmi; beloved of Mrida (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: महारूपा महापूज्या महापातक नाशिनी । महामाया महासत्त्वा महाशक्ति र्महारतिः ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.iast: mahārūpā, mahāpūjyā, mahāpātaka nāśinī । mahāmāyā, mahāsattvā, mahāśakti rmahāratiḥ ॥ 54 ॥
verses.meaning: Of vast form; supremely worthy of worship; destroyer of the gravest sins; The Great Illusion (Mahamaya); of great strength; the Great Power; of great delight.

verses.devanagari: महाभोगा महैश्वर्या महावीर्या महाबला । महाबुद्धि र्महासिद्धि र्महायोगेश्वरेश्वरी ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.iast: mahābhōgā, mahaiśvaryā, mahāvīryā, mahābalā । mahābuddhi, rmahāsiddhi, rmahāyōgēśvarēśvarī ॥ 55 ॥
verses.meaning: Of great enjoyment; of great sovereignty; of great valour; of great might; Of great intellect; of great attainments; ruler even of the great lords of yoga.

verses.devanagari: महातन्त्रा महामन्त्रा महायन्त्रा महासना । महायाग क्रमाराध्या महाभैरव पूजिता ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.iast: mahātantrā, mahāmantrā, mahāyantrā, mahāsanā । mahāyāga kramārādhyā, mahābhairava pūjitā ॥ 56 ॥
verses.meaning: Of the great tantras; of the great mantras; of the great yantras; of the great seat; Worshipped through the rites of the great sacrifice; worshipped by Mahabhairava.

verses.devanagari: महेश्वर महाकल्प महाताण्डव साक्षिणी । महाकामेश महिषी महात्रिपुर सुन्दरी ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.iast: mahēśvara mahākalpa mahātāṇḍava sākṣiṇī । mahākāmēśa mahiṣī, mahātripura sundarī ॥ 57 ॥
verses.meaning: Witness of the great cosmic dance of Maheshvara at the end of the great age (kalpa); Chief queen of Mahakamesha; Maha Tripura Sundari.

verses.devanagari: चतुःषष्ट्युपचाराढ्या चतुष्षष्टि कळामयी । महा चतुष्षष्टि कोटि योगिनी गणसेविता ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.iast: chatuḥṣaṣṭyupachārāḍhyā, chatuṣṣaṣṭi kaḻāmayī । mahā chatuṣṣaṣṭi kōṭi yōginī gaṇasēvitā ॥ 58 ॥
verses.meaning: Worthy of the sixty-four modes of worship; embodiment of the sixty-four arts; Served by the great hosts of sixty-four crore yoginis.

verses.devanagari: मनुविद्या चन्द्रविद्या चन्द्रमण्डलमध्यगा । चारुरूपा चारुहासा चारुचन्द्र कळाधरा ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.iast: manuvidyā, chandravidyā, chandramaṇḍalamadhyagā । chārurūpā, chāruhāsā, chāruchandra kaḻādharā ॥ 59 ॥
verses.meaning: The Manu-vidya; the Chandra-vidya; dwelling in the centre of the moon's disc; Of lovely form; of lovely smile; wearing the lovely crescent moon.

verses.devanagari: चराचर जगन्नाथा चक्रराज निकेतना । पार्वती पद्मनयना पद्मराग समप्रभा ॥ ६० ॥
verses.iast: charāchara jagannāthā, chakrarāja nikētanā । pārvatī, padmanayanā, padmarāga samaprabhā ॥ 60 ॥
verses.meaning: Ruler of the moving and unmoving world; dwelling in the Sri Chakra; Parvati (daughter of the mountain); lotus-eyed; radiant as a ruby.

verses.devanagari: पञ्चप्रेतासनासीना पञ्चब्रह्म स्वरूपिणी । चिन्मयी परमानन्दा विज्ञान घनरूपिणी ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.iast: pañchaprētāsanāsīnā, pañchabrahma svarūpiṇī । chinmayī, paramānandā, vijñāna ghanarūpiṇī ॥ 61 ॥
verses.meaning: Seated on the seat of the five corpses (pancha-preta); embodiment of the five Brahmas; Full of consciousness; supreme bliss; a dense mass of wisdom.

verses.devanagari: ध्यानध्यात्ड़् ध्येयरूपा धर्माधर्म विवर्जिता । विश्वरूपा जागरिणी स्वपन्ती तैजसात्मिका ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.iast: dhyānadhyātṛ dhyēyarūpā, dharmādharma vivarjitā । viśvarūpā, jāgariṇī, svapantī, taijasātmikā ॥ 62 ॥
verses.meaning: Who is meditation, the meditator and the object of meditation; beyond merit and demerit; Of universal form (Vishva); the waking state; the dreaming state; whose nature is Taijasa;

verses.devanagari: सुप्ता प्राज्ञात्मिका तुर्या सर्वावस्था विवर्जिता । स्ड़्ष्टिकर्त्री ब्रह्मरूपा गोप्त्री गोविन्दरूपिणी ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.iast: suptā, prājñātmikā, turyā, sarvāvasthā vivarjitā । sṛṣṭikartrī, brahmarūpā, gōptrī, gōvindarūpiṇī ॥ 63 ॥
verses.meaning: The deep-sleep state; whose nature is Prajna; the fourth state (Turiya); beyond all states; The Creator; of the form of Brahma; the Protector; of the form of Govinda (Vishnu);

verses.devanagari: संहारिणी रुद्ररूपा तिरोधानकरीश्वरी । सदाशिवानुग्रहदा पञ्चक्ड़्त्य परायणा ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.iast: saṃhāriṇī, rudrarūpā, tirōdhānakarīśvarī । sadāśivānugrahadā, pañchakṛtya parāyaṇā ॥ 64 ॥
verses.meaning: The Destroyer; of the form of Rudra; the goddess who brings about concealment (Tirodhana); Who grants grace as Sadashiva; devoted to the five cosmic functions.

verses.devanagari: भानुमण्डल मध्यस्था भैरवी भगमालिनी । पद्मासना भगवती पद्मनाभ सहोदरी ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.iast: bhānumaṇḍala madhyasthā, bhairavī, bhagamālinī । padmāsanā, bhagavatī, padmanābha sahōdarī ॥ 65 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the centre of the sun's disc; Bhairavi; wearing the garland of the Bhaga goddesses; Seated on a lotus; the Blessed One (Bhagavati); sister of Padmanabha (Vishnu).

verses.devanagari: उन्मेष निमिषोत्पन्न विपन्न भुवनावळिः । सहस्रशीर्षवदना सहस्राक्षी सहस्रपात् ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.iast: unmēṣa nimiṣōtpanna vipanna bhuvanāvaḻiḥ । sahasraśīrṣavadanā, sahasrākṣī, sahasrapāt ॥ 66 ॥
verses.meaning: Who creates and dissolves whole rows of worlds as her eyes open and close; Having a thousand heads and faces; a thousand eyes; a thousand feet.

verses.devanagari: आब्रह्म कीटजननी वर्णाश्रम विधायिनी । निजाज्ञारूपनिगमा पुण्यापुण्य फलप्रदा ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.iast: ābrahma kīṭajananī, varṇāśrama vidhāyinī । nijājñārūpanigamā, puṇyāpuṇya phalapradā ॥ 67 ॥
verses.meaning: Mother of all beings, from Brahma to the smallest insect; establisher of the order of varna and ashrama; Whose command takes the form of the Vedas; giver of the fruits of merit and demerit.

verses.devanagari: श्रुति सीमन्त सिन्धूरीक्ड़्त पादाब्जधूळिका । सकलागम सन्दोह शुक्तिसम्पुट मौक्तिका ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.iast: śruti sīmanta sindhūrīkṛta pādābjadhūḻikā । sakalāgama sandōha śuktisampuṭa mauktikā ॥ 68 ॥
verses.meaning: The dust of whose lotus feet is the vermilion in the hair-parting of the Vedas; The pearl within the shell formed by all the scriptures (Agamas).

verses.devanagari: पुरुषार्थप्रदा पूर्णा भोगिनी भुवनेश्वरी । अम्बिकाऽनादि निधना हरिब्रह्मेन्द्र सेविता ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.iast: puruṣārthapradā, pūrṇā, bhōginī, bhuvanēśvarī । ambikā,'nādi nidhanā, haribrahmēndra sēvitā ॥ 69 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of the goals of life; the Complete One; the Enjoyer; Ruler of the worlds (Bhuvaneshvari); The Mother (Ambika); without beginning or end; served by Hari, Brahma and Indra.

verses.devanagari: नारायणी नादरूपा नामरूप विवर्जिता । ह्रीङ्कारी ह्रीमती ह्ड़्द्या हेयोपादेय वर्जिता ॥ ७० ॥
verses.iast: nārāyaṇī, nādarūpā, nāmarūpa vivarjitā । hrīṅkārī, hrīmatī, hṛdyā, hēyōpādēya varjitā ॥ 70 ॥
verses.meaning: Narayani; whose form is sound (nada); beyond name and form; Of the form of the syllable Hrim; full of modesty; dear to the heart; beyond what is to be rejected or accepted.

verses.devanagari: राजराजार्चिता राज्ञी रम्या राजीवलोचना । रञ्जनी रमणी रस्या रणत्किङ्किणि मेखला ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.iast: rājarājārchitā, rājñī, ramyā, rājīvalōchanā । rañjanī, ramaṇī, rasyā, raṇatkiṅkiṇi mēkhalā ॥ 71 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped by the king of kings (Kubera); the Queen; delightful; lotus-eyed; Who gladdens; who enchants; full of sweetness (rasa); wearing a girdle with tinkling bells.

verses.devanagari: रमा राकेन्दुवदना रतिरूपा रतिप्रिया । रक्षाकरी राक्षसघ्नी रामा रमणलम्पटा ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.iast: ramā, rākēnduvadanā, ratirūpā, ratipriyā । rakṣākarī, rākṣasaghnī, rāmā, ramaṇalampaṭā ॥ 72 ॥
verses.meaning: Rama (Lakshmi); with a face like the full moon; of the form of Rati; fond of Rati (love); Protector; slayer of demons; the beautiful woman; devoted to her beloved (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: काम्या कामकळारूपा कदम्ब कुसुमप्रिया । कळ्याणी जगतीकन्दा करुणारस सागरा ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.iast: kāmyā, kāmakaḻārūpā, kadamba kusumapriyā । kaḻyāṇī, jagatīkandā, karuṇārasa sāgarā ॥ 73 ॥
verses.meaning: The desirable one; embodiment of Kama-kala; fond of kadamba flowers; The auspicious one (Kalyani); the root of the world; an ocean of the nectar of compassion.

verses.devanagari: कळावती कळालापा कान्ता कादम्बरीप्रिया । वरदा वामनयना वारुणीमदविह्वला ॥ ७४ ॥
verses.iast: kaḻāvatī, kaḻālāpā, kāntā, kādambarīpriyā । varadā, vāmanayanā, vāruṇīmadavihvalā ॥ 74 ॥
verses.meaning: Possessing all the arts; of sweet speech; the beloved; fond of kadambari (mead); Giver of boons; with beautiful eyes; overcome with the wine of bliss (Varuni).

verses.devanagari: विश्वाधिका वेदवेद्या विन्ध्याचल निवासिनी । विधात्री वेदजननी विष्णुमाया विलासिनी ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.iast: viśvādhikā, vēdavēdyā, vindhyāchala nivāsinī । vidhātrī, vēdajananī, viṣṇumāyā, vilāsinī ॥ 75 ॥
verses.meaning: Transcending the universe; known through the Vedas; dwelling in the Vindhya mountains; Sustainer of the universe; mother of the Vedas; the maya of Vishnu; the playful one.

verses.devanagari: क्षेत्रस्वरूपा क्षेत्रेशी क्षेत्र क्षेत्रज्ञ पालिनी । क्षयव्ड़्द्धि विनिर्मुक्ता क्षेत्रपाल समर्चिता ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.iast: kṣētrasvarūpā, kṣētrēśī, kṣētra kṣētrajña pālinī । kṣayavṛddhi vinirmuktā, kṣētrapāla samarchitā ॥ 76 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is the field (the body); ruler of the field; protector of the field and its knower; Free of decay and growth; worshipped by the guardians of the field (Kshetrapalas).

verses.devanagari: विजया विमला वन्द्या वन्दारु जनवत्सला । वाग्वादिनी वामकेशी वह्निमण्डल वासिनी ॥ ७७ ॥
verses.iast: vijayā, vimalā, vandyā, vandāru janavatsalā । vāgvādinī, vāmakēśī, vahnimaṇḍala vāsinī ॥ 77 ॥
verses.meaning: Victorious; spotless; worthy of adoration; loving to those who worship her; Goddess of speech; with beautiful hair; dwelling in the disc of fire.

verses.devanagari: भक्तिमत्कल्पलतिका पशुपाश विमोचनी । संह्ड़्ताशेष पाषण्डा सदाचार प्रवर्तिका ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.iast: bhaktimat-kalpalatikā, paśupāśa vimōchanī । saṃhṛtāśēṣa pāṣaṇḍā, sadāchāra pravartikā ॥ 78 ॥
verses.meaning: The wish-fulfilling creeper for the devout; who frees the bound soul (pashu) from its bonds; Who has destroyed all heretics; who establishes right conduct.

verses.devanagari: तापत्रयाग्नि सन्तप्त समाह्लादन चन्द्रिका । तरुणी तापसाराध्या तनुमध्या तमोऽपहा ॥ ७९ ॥
verses.iast: tāpatrayāgni santapta samāhlādana chandrikā । taruṇī, tāpasārādhyā, tanumadhyā, tamō'pahā ॥ 79 ॥
verses.meaning: The moonlight that soothes those scorched by the fire of the three afflictions; Ever youthful; worshipped by ascetics; slender-waisted; remover of darkness (ignorance).

verses.devanagari: चिति स्तत्पदलक्ष्यार्था चिदेक रसरूपिणी । स्वात्मानन्दलवीभूत ब्रह्माद्यानन्द सन्ततिः ॥ ८० ॥
verses.iast: chiti, statpadalakṣyārthā, chidēka rasarūpiṇī । svātmānandalavībhūta brahmādyānanda santatiḥ ॥ 80 ॥
verses.meaning: Pure consciousness (Chiti); the meaning pointed to by the word 'Tat' (That); whose nature is the single essence of consciousness; From a mere particle of whose bliss arise the joys of Brahma and all others.

verses.devanagari: परा प्रत्यक्चिती रूपा पश्यन्ती परदेवता । मध्यमा वैखरीरूपा भक्तमानस हंसिका ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.iast: parā, pratyakchitī rūpā, paśyantī, paradēvatā । madhyamā, vaikharīrūpā, bhaktamānasa haṃsikā ॥ 81 ॥
verses.meaning: Para (the supreme level of speech); whose form is inward consciousness; Pashyanti; the supreme deity; Madhyama; whose form is Vaikhari (spoken word); the swan in the minds of devotees.

verses.devanagari: कामेश्वर प्राणनाडी क्ड़्तज्ञा कामपूजिता । श्ड़्ङ्गार रससम्पूर्णा जया जालन्धरस्थिता ॥ ८२ ॥
verses.iast: kāmēśvara prāṇanāḍī, kṛtajñā, kāmapūjitā । śṛṅgāra rasasampūrṇā, jayā, jālandharasthitā ॥ 82 ॥
verses.meaning: The life-breath of Kameshvara; knower of all deeds (grateful); worshipped by Kama; Full of the essence of love (shringara); the Victorious (Jaya); dwelling in the Jalandhara seat.

verses.devanagari: ओड्याण पीठनिलया बिन्दुमण्डल वासिनी । रहोयाग क्रमाराध्या रहस्तर्पण तर्पिता ॥ ८३ ॥
verses.iast: ōḍyāṇa pīṭhanilayā, bindumaṇḍala vāsinī । rahōyāga kramārādhyā, rahastarpaṇa tarpitā ॥ 83 ॥
verses.meaning: Residing in the Odyana seat (pitha); dwelling in the bindu-mandala, the centre of the Sri Chakra; Worshipped through secret inner rites; pleased by secret offerings.

verses.devanagari: सद्यः प्रसादिनी विश्वसाक्षिणी साक्षिवर्जिता । षडङ्गदेवता युक्ता षाड्गुण्य परिपूरिता ॥ ८४ ॥
verses.iast: sadyaḥ prasādinī, viśvasākṣiṇī, sākṣivarjitā । ṣaḍaṅgadēvatā yuktā, ṣāḍguṇya paripūritā ॥ 84 ॥
verses.meaning: Who grants grace at once; witness of the universe; with no witness beyond her; Accompanied by the deities of the six limbs; complete with the six excellences.

verses.devanagari: नित्यक्लिन्ना निरुपमा निर्वाण सुखदायिनी । नित्या षोडशिकारूपा श्रीकण्ठार्ध शरीरिणी ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.iast: nityaklinnā, nirupamā, nirvāṇa sukhadāyinī । nityā, ṣōḍaśikārūpā, śrīkaṇṭhārdha śarīriṇī ॥ 85 ॥
verses.meaning: Ever compassionate (Nityaklinna); incomparable; giver of the bliss of liberation (nirvana); The Nitya goddesses; of the form of Shodashi; who forms half the body of Shrikantha (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: प्रभावती प्रभारूपा प्रसिद्धा परमेश्वरी । मूलप्रक्ड़्ति रव्यक्ता व्यक्ताऽव्यक्त स्वरूपिणी ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.iast: prabhāvatī, prabhārūpā, prasiddhā, paramēśvarī । mūlaprakṛti ravyaktā, vyaktā'vyakta svarūpiṇī ॥ 86 ॥
verses.meaning: Radiant; whose form is light; renowned; the supreme ruler; Primordial nature (Mulaprakriti); the unmanifest; whose nature is both manifest and unmanifest.

verses.devanagari: व्यापिनी विविधाकारा विद्याऽविद्या स्वरूपिणी । महाकामेश नयना कुमुदाह्लाद कौमुदी ॥ ८७ ॥
verses.iast: vyāpinī, vividhākārā, vidyā'vidyā svarūpiṇī । mahākāmēśa nayanā kumudāhlāda kaumudī ॥ 87 ॥
verses.meaning: All-pervading; of many forms; whose nature is both knowledge and ignorance; The moonlight that delights the lily-like eyes of Mahakamesha.

verses.devanagari: भक्तहार्द तमोभेद भानुमद्भानुसन्ततिः । शिवदूती शिवाराध्या शिवमूर्ति श्शिवङ्करी ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.iast: bhaktahārda tamōbhēda bhānumad-bhānusantatiḥ । śivadūtī, śivārādhyā, śivamūrti, śśivaṅkarī ॥ 88 ॥
verses.meaning: A stream of sunrays dispelling the darkness in devotees' hearts; Who made Shiva her messenger; worshipped by Shiva; of the form of Shiva; who does good (Shivankari).

verses.devanagari: शिवप्रिया शिवपरा शिष्टेष्टा शिष्टपूजिता । अप्रमेया स्वप्रकाशा मनोवाचाम गोचरा ॥ ८९ ॥
verses.iast: śivapriyā, śivaparā, śiṣṭēṣṭā, śiṣṭapūjitā । apramēyā, svaprakāśā, manōvāchāma gōcharā ॥ 89 ॥
verses.meaning: Beloved of Shiva; wholly devoted to Shiva; dear to the righteous; worshipped by the righteous; Immeasurable; self-luminous; beyond the reach of mind and speech.

verses.devanagari: चिच्छक्ति श्चेतनारूपा जडशक्ति र्जडात्मिका । गायत्री व्याह्ड़्ति स्सन्ध्या द्विजब्ड़्न्द निषेविता ॥ ९० ॥
verses.iast: chichChakti, śchētanārūpā, jaḍaśakti, rjaḍātmikā । gāyatrī, vyāhṛti, ssandhyā, dvijabṛnda niṣēvitā ॥ 90 ॥
verses.meaning: The power of consciousness; whose form is awareness; the power of inert matter; who is inert matter itself; Gayatri; the Vyahritis (Bhur, Bhuvah, Suvah); Sandhya (twilight worship); served by the twice-born.

verses.devanagari: तत्त्वासना तत्त्वमयी पञ्चकोशान्तरस्थिता । निस्सीममहिमा नित्ययौवना मदशालिनी ॥ ९१ ॥
verses.iast: tattvāsanā, tattvamayī, pañchakōśāntarasthitā । nissīmamahimā, nityayauvanā, madaśālinī ॥ 91 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose seat is the tattvas; made of the tattvas; dwelling within the five sheaths (koshas); Of boundless glory; ever youthful; radiant with ecstasy.

verses.devanagari: मदघूर्णित रक्ताक्षी मदपाटल गण्डभूः । चन्दन द्रवदिग्धाङ्गी चाम्पेय कुसुम प्रिया ॥ ९२ ॥
verses.iast: madaghūrṇita raktākṣī, madapāṭala gaṇḍabhūḥ । chandana dravadigdhāṅgī, chāmpēya kusuma priyā ॥ 92 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose reddened eyes roll in ecstasy; whose cheeks are flushed with ecstasy; Whose body is anointed with sandal paste; fond of champaka flowers.

verses.devanagari: कुशला कोमलाकारा कुरुकुळ्ळा कुलेश्वरी । कुळकुण्डालया कौळ मार्गतत्पर सेविता ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.iast: kuśalā, kōmalākārā, kurukuḻḻā, kulēśvarī । kuḻakuṇḍālayā, kauḻa mārgatatpara sēvitā ॥ 93 ॥
verses.meaning: Skilful; of tender form; Kurukulla; ruler of Kula; Dwelling in the Kula-kunda (Muladhara); served by those devoted to the Kaula path.

verses.devanagari: कुमार गणनाथाम्बा तुष्टिः पुष्टि र्मति र्ध्ड़्तिः । शान्तिः स्वस्तिमती कान्ति र्नन्दिनी विघ्ननाशिनी ॥ ९४ ॥
verses.iast: kumāra gaṇanāthāmbā, tuṣṭiḥ, puṣṭi, rmati, rdhṛtiḥ । śāntiḥ, svastimatī, kānti, rnandinī, vighnanāśinī ॥ 94 ॥
verses.meaning: Mother of Kumara (Skanda) and Gananatha (Ganesha); contentment; nourishment; intellect; steadfastness; Peace; well-being; brilliance; joy (Nandini); destroyer of obstacles.

verses.devanagari: तेजोवती त्रिनयना लोलाक्षी कामरूपिणी । मालिनी हंसिनी माता मलयाचल वासिनी ॥ ९५ ॥
verses.iast: tējōvatī, trinayanā, lōlākṣī kāmarūpiṇī । mālinī, haṃsinī, mātā, malayāchala vāsinī ॥ 95 ॥
verses.meaning: Full of splendour; three-eyed; with playful eyes; who takes any form at will; Wearing a garland (Malini); the swan (Hamsini); the Mother; dwelling on the Malaya mountain.

verses.devanagari: सुमुखी नळिनी सुभ्रूः शोभना सुरनायिका । कालकण्ठी कान्तिमती क्षोभिणी सूक्ष्मरूपिणी ॥ ९६ ॥
verses.iast: sumukhī, naḻinī, subhrūḥ, śōbhanā, suranāyikā । kālakaṇṭhī, kāntimatī, kṣōbhiṇī, sūkṣmarūpiṇī ॥ 96 ॥
verses.meaning: Beautiful-faced; lotus-like (Nalini); with lovely eyebrows; radiant; leader of the gods; Consort of the dark-throated one (Shiva); full of lustre; who stirs creation into motion; of subtle form.

verses.devanagari: वज्रेश्वरी वामदेवी वयोऽवस्था विवर्जिता । सिद्धेश्वरी सिद्धविद्या सिद्धमाता यशस्विनी ॥ ९७ ॥
verses.iast: vajrēśvarī, vāmadēvī, vayō'vasthā vivarjitā । siddhēśvarī, siddhavidyā, siddhamātā, yaśasvinī ॥ 97 ॥
verses.meaning: Vajreshvari; consort of Vamadeva; untouched by the stages of age; Ruler of the Siddhas; the Siddha-vidya; mother of the Siddhas; glorious.

verses.devanagari: विशुद्धि चक्रनिलयाऽऽरक्तवर्णा त्रिलोचना । खट्वाङ्गादि प्रहरणा वदनैक समन्विता ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.iast: viśuddhi chakranilayā,''raktavarṇā, trilōchanā । khaṭvāṅgādi praharaṇā, vadanaika samanvitā ॥ 98 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the Vishuddhi chakra; rosy-red in colour; three-eyed; Armed with the khatvanga and other weapons; having one face;

verses.devanagari: पायसान्नप्रिया त्वक्स्था पशुलोक भयङ्करी । अम्ड़्तादि महाशक्ति संव्ड़्ता डाकिनीश्वरी ॥ ९९ ॥
verses.iast: pāyasānnapriyā, tvaksthā, paśulōka bhayaṅkarī । amṛtādi mahāśakti saṃvṛtā, ḍākinīśvarī ॥ 99 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of sweet rice pudding (payasa); presiding over the skin; frightening to the ignorant; Surrounded by Amrita and the other great Shaktis; the ruler Dakini.

verses.devanagari: अनाहताब्ज निलया श्यामाभा वदनद्वया । दंष्ट्रोज्ज्वलाऽक्षमालाधिधरा रुधिर संस्थिता ॥ १०० ॥
verses.iast: anāhatābja nilayā, śyāmābhā, vadanadvayā । daṃṣṭrōjjvalā,'kṣamālādhidharā, rudhira saṃsthitā ॥ 100 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the Anahata lotus; dark in complexion; having two faces; Shining with tusks; holding a rosary; presiding over the blood;

verses.devanagari: काळरात्र्यादि शक्त्योघव्ड़्ता स्निग्धौदनप्रिया । महावीरेन्द्र वरदा राकिण्यम्बा स्वरूपिणी ॥ १०१ ॥
verses.iast: kāḻarātryādi śaktyōghavṛtā, snigdhaudanapriyā । mahāvīrēndra varadā, rākiṇyambā svarūpiṇī ॥ 101 ॥
verses.meaning: Surrounded by Kalaratri and the other Shaktis; fond of rice cooked with ghee; Giver of boons to great heroes; who is the mother Rakini.

verses.devanagari: मणिपूराब्ज निलया वदनत्रय संयुता । वज्राधिकायुधोपेता डामर्यादिभि राव्ड़्ता ॥ १०२ ॥
verses.iast: maṇipūrābja nilayā, vadanatraya saṃyutā । vajrādhikāyudhōpētā, ḍāmaryādibhi rāvṛtā ॥ 102 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the Manipura lotus; having three faces; Bearing the thunderbolt and other weapons; surrounded by Damari and others;

verses.devanagari: रक्तवर्णा मांसनिष्ठा गुडान्न प्रीतमानसा । समस्त भक्तसुखदा लाकिन्यम्बा स्वरूपिणी ॥ १०३ ॥
verses.iast: raktavarṇā, māṃsaniṣṭhā, guḍānna prītamānasā । samasta bhaktasukhadā, lākinyambā svarūpiṇī ॥ 103 ॥
verses.meaning: Red in colour; presiding over the flesh; delighting in rice with jaggery; Giver of happiness to all devotees; who is the mother Lakini.

verses.devanagari: स्वाधिष्ठानाम्बु जगता चतुर्वक्त्र मनोहरा । शूलाद्यायुध सम्पन्ना पीतवर्णाऽतिगर्विता ॥ १०४ ॥
verses.iast: svādhiṣṭhānāmbu jagatā, chaturvaktra manōharā । śūlādyāyudha sampannā, pītavarṇā,'tigarvitā ॥ 104 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the Svadhishthana lotus; charming with four faces; Armed with the trident and other weapons; yellow in colour; very proud;

verses.devanagari: मेदोनिष्ठा मधुप्रीता बन्दिन्यादि समन्विता । दध्यन्नासक्त ह्ड़्दया काकिनी रूपधारिणी ॥ १०५ ॥
verses.iast: mēdōniṣṭhā, madhuprītā, bandinyādi samanvitā । dadhyannāsakta hṛdayā, kākinī rūpadhāriṇī ॥ 105 ॥
verses.meaning: Presiding over the fat; fond of honey; accompanied by Bandini and others; Fond of curd rice; who takes the form of Kakini.

verses.devanagari: मूला धाराम्बुजारूढा पञ्चवक्त्राऽस्थिसंस्थिता । अङ्कुशादि प्रहरणा वरदादि निषेविता ॥ १०६ ॥
verses.iast: mūlā dhārāmbujārūḍhā, pañchavaktrā,'sthisaṃsthitā । aṅkuśādi praharaṇā, varadādi niṣēvitā ॥ 106 ॥
verses.meaning: Seated on the Muladhara lotus; five-faced; presiding over the bones; Bearing the goad and other weapons; attended by Varada and others;

verses.devanagari: मुद्गौदनासक्त चित्ता साकिन्यम्बास्वरूपिणी । आज्ञा चक्राब्जनिलया शुक्लवर्णा षडानना ॥ १०७ ॥
verses.iast: mudgaudanāsakta chittā, sākinyambāsvarūpiṇī । ājñā chakrābjanilayā, śuklavarṇā, ṣaḍānanā ॥ 107 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of rice cooked with mung dal; who is the mother Sakini; Dwelling in the lotus of the Ajna chakra; white in colour; six-faced;

verses.devanagari: मज्जासंस्था हंसवती मुख्यशक्ति समन्विता । हरिद्रान्नैक रसिका हाकिनी रूपधारिणी ॥ १०८ ॥
verses.iast: majjāsaṃsthā, haṃsavatī mukhyaśakti samanvitā । haridrānnaika rasikā, hākinī rūpadhāriṇī ॥ 108 ॥
verses.meaning: Presiding over the marrow; accompanied by Hamsavati and the other chief Shaktis; Fond of turmeric rice; who takes the form of Hakini.

verses.devanagari: सहस्रदळ पद्मस्था सर्ववर्णोप शोभिता । सर्वायुधधरा शुक्ल संस्थिता सर्वतोमुखी ॥ १०९ ॥
verses.iast: sahasradaḻa padmasthā, sarvavarṇōpa śōbhitā । sarvāyudhadharā, śukla saṃsthitā, sarvatōmukhī ॥ 109 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling in the thousand-petalled lotus; shining with all colours; Bearing all weapons; presiding over the vital essence (semen); facing every direction;

verses.devanagari: सर्वौदन प्रीतचित्ता याकिन्यम्बा स्वरूपिणी । स्वाहा स्वधाऽमति र्मेधा श्रुतिः स्म्ड़्ति रनुत्तमा ॥ ११० ॥
verses.iast: sarvaudana prītachittā, yākinyambā svarūpiṇī । svāhā, svadhā,'mati, rmēdhā, śrutiḥ, smṛti, ranuttamā ॥ 110 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of all kinds of rice offerings; who is the mother Yakini; Svaha; Svadha; ignorance (Amati); intelligence (Medha); the Veda (Shruti); tradition (Smriti); the unsurpassed.

verses.devanagari: पुण्यकीर्तिः पुण्यलभ्या पुण्यश्रवण कीर्तना । पुलोमजार्चिता बन्धमोचनी बन्धुरालका ॥ १११ ॥
verses.iast: puṇyakīrtiḥ, puṇyalabhyā, puṇyaśravaṇa kīrtanā । pulōmajārchitā, bandhamōchanī, bandhurālakā ॥ 111 ॥
verses.meaning: Of holy renown; attained through merit; hearing and singing of whom brings merit; Worshipped by Pulomaja (Indrani); who frees from bondage; with lovely curling hair.

verses.devanagari: विमर्शरूपिणी विद्या वियदादि जगत्प्रसूः । सर्वव्याधि प्रशमनी सर्वम्ड़्त्यु निवारिणी ॥ ११२ ॥
verses.iast: vimarśarūpiṇī, vidyā, viyadādi jagatprasūḥ । sarvavyādhi praśamanī, sarvamṛtyu nivāriṇī ॥ 112 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is Vimarsha (self-awareness); Knowledge (Vidya); mother of the universe beginning with space; Who cures all diseases; who wards off every kind of death.

verses.devanagari: अग्रगण्याऽचिन्त्यरूपा कलिकल्मष नाशिनी । कात्यायिनी कालहन्त्री कमलाक्ष निषेविता ॥ ११३ ॥
verses.iast: agragaṇyā,'chintyarūpā, kalikalmaṣa nāśinī । kātyāyinī, kālahantrī, kamalākṣa niṣēvitā ॥ 113 ॥
verses.meaning: Foremost of all; of inconceivable form; destroyer of the sins of the Kali age; Katyayani; destroyer of time (death); worshipped by the lotus-eyed Vishnu.

verses.devanagari: ताम्बूल पूरित मुखी दाडिमी कुसुमप्रभा । म्ड़्गाक्षी मोहिनी मुख्या म्ड़्डानी मित्ररूपिणी ॥ ११४ ॥
verses.iast: tāmbūla pūrita mukhī, dāḍimī kusumaprabhā । mṛgākṣī, mōhinī, mukhyā, mṛḍānī, mitrarūpiṇī ॥ 114 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose mouth is filled with betel; radiant like the pomegranate flower; Doe-eyed; enchantress; the foremost; consort of Mrida (Shiva); the friend of all.

verses.devanagari: नित्यत्ड़्प्ता भक्तनिधि र्नियन्त्री निखिलेश्वरी । मैत्र्यादि वासनालभ्या महाप्रळय साक्षिणी ॥ ११५ ॥
verses.iast: nityatṛptā, bhaktanidhi, rniyantrī, nikhilēśvarī । maitryādi vāsanālabhyā, mahāpraḻaya sākṣiṇī ॥ 115 ॥
verses.meaning: Ever content; treasure of devotees; the controller; ruler of all; Attained through friendliness and the other virtues; witness of the great dissolution.

verses.devanagari: पराशक्तिः परानिष्ठा प्रज्ञान घनरूपिणी । माध्वीपानालसा मत्ता मात्ड़्का वर्ण रूपिणी ॥ ११६ ॥
verses.iast: parāśaktiḥ, parāniṣṭhā, prajñāna ghanarūpiṇī । mādhvīpānālasā, mattā, mātṛkā varṇa rūpiṇī ॥ 116 ॥
verses.meaning: The supreme power; the supreme goal; a dense mass of wisdom (prajnana); Languid from drinking the nectar of bliss; intoxicated with bliss; whose form is the letters of the alphabet (Matrika).

verses.devanagari: महाकैलास निलया म्ड़्णाल म्ड़्दुदोर्लता । महनीया दयामूर्ती र्महासाम्राज्यशालिनी ॥ ११७ ॥
verses.iast: mahākailāsa nilayā, mṛṇāla mṛdudōrlatā । mahanīyā, dayāmūrtī, rmahāsāmrājyaśālinī ॥ 117 ॥
verses.meaning: Dwelling on the great Kailasa; whose arms are soft as lotus stalks; Worthy of adoration; embodiment of compassion; ruler of the great empire.

verses.devanagari: आत्मविद्या महाविद्या श्रीविद्या कामसेविता । श्रीषोडशाक्षरी विद्या त्रिकूटा कामकोटिका ॥ ११८ ॥
verses.iast: ātmavidyā, mahāvidyā, śrīvidyā, kāmasēvitā । śrīṣōḍaśākṣarī vidyā, trikūṭā, kāmakōṭikā ॥ 118 ॥
verses.meaning: Knowledge of the Self; the great knowledge; Sri Vidya; worshipped by Kama; The sixteen-syllable Sri Vidya mantra; the three-peaked mantra; dwelling in Kamakoti (Kanchi).

verses.devanagari: कटाक्षकिङ्करी भूत कमला कोटिसेविता । शिरःस्थिता चन्द्रनिभा फालस्थेन्द्र धनुःप्रभा ॥ ११९ ॥
verses.iast: kaṭākṣakiṅkarī bhūta kamalā kōṭisēvitā । śiraḥsthitā, chandranibhā, phālasthēndra dhanuḥprabhā ॥ 119 ॥
verses.meaning: Served by crores of Lakshmis who wait on her glance like servants; Abiding in the head; radiant like the moon; shining like a rainbow on the forehead;

verses.devanagari: ह्ड़्दयस्था रविप्रख्या त्रिकोणान्तर दीपिका । दाक्षायणी दैत्यहन्त्री दक्षयज्ञ विनाशिनी ॥ १२० ॥
verses.iast: hṛdayasthā, raviprakhyā, trikōṇāntara dīpikā । dākṣāyaṇī, daityahantrī, dakṣayajña vināśinī ॥ 120 ॥
verses.meaning: Abiding in the heart; brilliant as the sun; the light within the triangle; Dakshayani (daughter of Daksha); slayer of demons; destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice.

verses.devanagari: दरान्दोळित दीर्घाक्षी दरहासोज्ज्वलन्मुखी । गुरुमूर्ति र्गुणनिधि र्गोमाता गुहजन्मभूः ॥ १२१ ॥
verses.iast: darāndōḻita dīrghākṣī, darahāsōjjvalanmukhī । gurumūrti, rguṇanidhi, rgōmātā, guhajanmabhūḥ ॥ 121 ॥
verses.meaning: With long eyes that move gently; whose face shines with a gentle smile; Whose form is the Guru; treasury of virtues; mother of cows (Kamadhenu); birthplace of Guha (Skanda).

verses.devanagari: देवेशी दण्डनीतिस्था दहराकाश रूपिणी । प्रतिपन्मुख्य राकान्त तिथिमण्डल पूजिता ॥ १२२ ॥
verses.iast: dēvēśī, daṇḍanītisthā, daharākāśa rūpiṇī । pratipanmukhya rākānta tithimaṇḍala pūjitā ॥ 122 ॥
verses.meaning: Ruler of the gods; upholder of justice; whose form is the space within the heart (dahara); Worshipped through the lunar days, from the first day to the full moon.

verses.devanagari: कळात्मिका कळानाथा काव्यालाप विनोदिनी । सचामर रमावाणी सव्यदक्षिण सेविता ॥ १२३ ॥
verses.iast: kaḻātmikā, kaḻānāthā, kāvyālāpa vinōdinī । sachāmara ramāvāṇī savyadakṣiṇa sēvitā ॥ 123 ॥
verses.meaning: Embodiment of the arts (kalas); lord of the arts (the moon); delighting in poetic discourse; Attended on her left and right by Lakshmi and Sarasvati holding chowries (fans).

verses.devanagari: आदिशक्ति रमेयाऽऽत्मा परमा पावनाक्ड़्तिः । अनेककोटि ब्रह्माण्ड जननी दिव्यविग्रहा ॥ १२४ ॥
verses.iast: ādiśakti, ramēyā,''tmā, paramā, pāvanākṛtiḥ । anēkakōṭi brahmāṇḍa jananī, divyavigrahā ॥ 124 ॥
verses.meaning: The Primal Power; immeasurable; the Self; the Supreme; of purifying form; Mother of countless crores of universes; of divine form.

verses.devanagari: क्लीङ्कारी केवला गुह्या कैवल्य पददायिनी । त्रिपुरा त्रिजगद्वन्द्या त्रिमूर्ति स्त्रिदशेश्वरी ॥ १२५ ॥
verses.iast: klīṅkārī, kēvalā, guhyā, kaivalya padadāyinī । tripurā, trijagadvandyā, trimūrti, stridaśēśvarī ॥ 125 ॥
verses.meaning: Of the form of the syllable Klim; the only one; the secret one; giver of liberation (kaivalya); Tripura; adored by the three worlds; the Trinity (Trimurti); ruler of the gods.

verses.devanagari: त्र्यक्षरी दिव्यगन्धाढ्या सिन्धूर तिलकाञ्चिता । उमा शैलेन्द्रतनया गौरी गन्धर्व सेविता ॥ १२६ ॥
verses.iast: tryakṣarī, divyagandhāḍhyā, sindhūra tilakāñchitā । umā, śailēndratanayā, gaurī, gandharva sēvitā ॥ 126 ॥
verses.meaning: Of three syllables; rich with divine fragrance; adorned with a vermilion tilaka; Uma; daughter of the king of mountains; the fair one (Gauri); served by the Gandharvas.

verses.devanagari: विश्वगर्भा स्वर्णगर्भाऽवरदा वागधीश्वरी । ध्यानगम्याऽपरिच्छेद्या ज्ञानदा ज्ञानविग्रहा ॥ १२७ ॥
verses.iast: viśvagarbhā, svarṇagarbhā,'varadā vāgadhīśvarī । dhyānagamyā,'parichChēdyā, jñānadā, jñānavigrahā ॥ 127 ॥
verses.meaning: Who holds the universe in her womb; the golden womb (Hiranyagarbha); slayer of demons (Avarada); ruler of speech; Reached through meditation; beyond all limits; giver of knowledge; embodiment of knowledge.

verses.devanagari: सर्ववेदान्त संवेद्या सत्यानन्द स्वरूपिणी । लोपामुद्रार्चिता लीलाकॢप्त ब्रह्माण्डमण्डला ॥ १२८ ॥
verses.iast: sarvavēdānta saṃvēdyā, satyānanda svarūpiṇī । lōpāmudrārchitā, līlākḷpta brahmāṇḍamaṇḍalā ॥ 128 ॥
verses.meaning: Known through all of Vedanta; whose nature is truth and bliss; Worshipped by Lopamudra; who creates the universes as play.

verses.devanagari: अद्ड़्श्या द्ड़्श्यरहिता विज्ञात्री वेद्यवर्जिता । योगिनी योगदा योग्या योगानन्दा युगन्धरा ॥ १२९ ॥
verses.iast: adṛśyā, dṛśyarahitā, vijñātrī, vēdyavarjitā । yōginī, yōgadā, yōgyā, yōgānandā, yugandharā ॥ 129 ॥
verses.meaning: Invisible; with nothing else to be seen; the knower; with nothing else to be known; The Yogini; giver of yoga; the fit goal of yoga; the bliss of yoga; upholder of the ages.

verses.devanagari: इच्छाशक्ति ज्ञानशक्ति क्रियाशक्ति स्वरूपिणी । सर्वाधारा सुप्रतिष्ठा सदसद्रूपधारिणी ॥ १३० ॥
verses.iast: ichChāśakti jñānaśakti kriyāśakti svarūpiṇī । sarvādhārā, supratiṣṭhā, sadasad-rūpadhāriṇī ॥ 130 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is the powers of will, knowledge and action; The support of all; firmly established; who takes the forms of both the real and the unreal.

verses.devanagari: अष्टमूर्ति रजाजैत्री लोकयात्रा विधायिनी । एकाकिनी भूमरूपा निर्द्वैता द्वैतवर्जिता ॥ १३१ ॥
verses.iast: aṣṭamūrti, rajājaitrī, lōkayātrā vidhāyinī । ēkākinī, bhūmarūpā, nirdvaitā, dvaitavarjitā ॥ 131 ॥
verses.meaning: Of eight forms; conqueror of ignorance; who carries on the affairs of the world; The solitary one; of the form of the whole (Bhuma); non-dual; beyond duality.

verses.devanagari: अन्नदा वसुदा व्ड़्द्धा ब्रह्मात्मैक्य स्वरूपिणी । ब्ढ़ती ब्राह्मणी ब्राह्मी ब्रह्मानन्दा बलिप्रिया ॥ १३२ ॥
verses.iast: annadā, vasudā, vṛddhā, brahmātmaikya svarūpiṇī । bṛhatī, brāhmaṇī, brāhmī, brahmānandā, balipriyā ॥ 132 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of food; giver of wealth; the ancient one; whose nature is the oneness of Brahman and the Self; The vast one (Brihati); Brahmani; Brahmi (Sarasvati); the bliss of Brahman; fond of offerings (bali).

verses.devanagari: भाषारूपा ब्ढ़त्सेना भावाभाव विवर्जिता । सुखाराध्या शुभकरी शोभना सुलभागतिः ॥ १३३ ॥
verses.iast: bhāṣārūpā, bṛhatsēnā, bhāvābhāva vivarjitā । sukhārādhyā, śubhakarī, śōbhanā sulabhāgatiḥ ॥ 133 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is language; with a vast army; beyond existence and non-existence; Easily worshipped; doer of good; radiant; the easily reached goal.

verses.devanagari: राजराजेश्वरी राज्यदायिनी राज्यवल्लभा । राजत्क्ड़्पा राजपीठ निवेशित निजाश्रिताः ॥ १३४ ॥
verses.iast: rājarājēśvarī, rājyadāyinī, rājyavallabhā । rājat-kṛpā, rājapīṭha nivēśita nijāśritāḥ ॥ 134 ॥
verses.meaning: Rajarajeshvari (queen of the king of kings); giver of kingdoms; beloved of kingdoms; Whose grace shines; who seats those who take refuge in her on royal thrones.

verses.devanagari: राज्यलक्ष्मीः कोशनाथा चतुरङ्ग बलेश्वरी । साम्राज्यदायिनी सत्यसन्धा सागरमेखला ॥ १३५ ॥
verses.iast: rājyalakṣmīḥ, kōśanāthā, chaturaṅga balēśvarī । sāmrājyadāyinī, satyasandhā, sāgaramēkhalā ॥ 135 ॥
verses.meaning: The fortune (Lakshmi) of the kingdom; mistress of the treasury; commander of the four-fold army; Giver of empires; true to her word; whose girdle is the ocean (the earth).

verses.devanagari: दीक्षिता दैत्यशमनी सर्वलोक वशङ्करी । सर्वार्थदात्री सावित्री सच्चिदानन्द रूपिणी ॥ १३६ ॥
verses.iast: dīkṣitā, daityaśamanī, sarvalōka vaśaṅkarī । sarvārthadātrī, sāvitrī, sachchidānanda rūpiṇī ॥ 136 ॥
verses.meaning: Consecrated (Dikshita); queller of demons; who brings all the worlds under her sway; Giver of all desires; Savitri; whose form is Sat-Chit-Ananda (being, consciousness and bliss).

verses.devanagari: देशकालाऽपरिच्छिन्ना सर्वगा सर्वमोहिनी । सरस्वती शास्त्रमयी गुहाम्बा गुह्यरूपिणी ॥ १३७ ॥
verses.iast: dēśakālā'parichChinnā, sarvagā, sarvamōhinī । sarasvatī, śāstramayī, guhāmbā, guhyarūpiṇī ॥ 137 ॥
verses.meaning: Unlimited by space and time; all-pervading; who enchants all; Sarasvati; embodiment of the scriptures; mother of Guha; whose form is secret.

verses.devanagari: सर्वोपाधि विनिर्मुक्ता सदाशिव पतिव्रता । सम्प्रदायेश्वरी साध्वी गुरुमण्डल रूपिणी ॥ १३८ ॥
verses.iast: sarvōpādhi vinirmuktā, sadāśiva pativratā । sampradāyēśvarī, sādhvī, gurumaṇḍala rūpiṇī ॥ 138 ॥
verses.meaning: Free from all limiting conditions; devoted wife of Sadashiva; Ruler of the traditions (sampradaya); the virtuous one; whose form is the circle of Gurus.

verses.devanagari: कुलोत्तीर्णा भगाराध्या माया मधुमती मही । गणाम्बा गुह्यकाराध्या कोमलाङ्गी गुरुप्रिया ॥ १३९ ॥
verses.iast: kulōttīrṇā, bhagārādhyā, māyā, madhumatī, mahī । gaṇāmbā, guhyakārādhyā, kōmalāṅgī, gurupriyā ॥ 139 ॥
verses.meaning: Beyond Kula; worshipped in the disc of the sun (Bhaga); Maya; sweet as honey (Madhumati); the Earth; Mother of the Ganas; worshipped by the Guhyakas; tender-limbed; beloved of the Guru.

verses.devanagari: स्वतन्त्रा सर्वतन्त्रेशी दक्षिणामूर्ति रूपिणी । सनकादि समाराध्या शिवज्ञान प्रदायिनी ॥ १४० ॥
verses.iast: svatantrā, sarvatantrēśī, dakṣiṇāmūrti rūpiṇī । sanakādi samārādhyā, śivajñāna pradāyinī ॥ 140 ॥
verses.meaning: Independent; ruler of all tantras; whose form is Dakshinamurti; Worshipped by Sanaka and the other sages; giver of the knowledge of Shiva.

verses.devanagari: चित्कळाऽनन्दकलिका प्रेमरूपा प्रियङ्करी । नामपारायण प्रीता नन्दिविद्या नटेश्वरी ॥ १४१ ॥
verses.iast: chitkaḻā,'nandakalikā, prēmarūpā, priyaṅkarī । nāmapārāyaṇa prītā, nandividyā, naṭēśvarī ॥ 141 ॥
verses.meaning: The spark (kala) of consciousness; the bud of bliss; embodiment of love; who does what is pleasing; Pleased by the recitation of her names; the Nandi-vidya; ruler of dancers (consort of Nataraja).

verses.devanagari: मिथ्या जगदधिष्ठाना मुक्तिदा मुक्तिरूपिणी । लास्यप्रिया लयकरी लज्जा रम्भादि वन्दिता ॥ १४२ ॥
verses.iast: mithyā jagadadhiṣṭhānā muktidā, muktirūpiṇī । lāsyapriyā, layakarī, lajjā, rambhādi vanditā ॥ 142 ॥
verses.meaning: The ground on which the illusory world rests; giver of liberation; embodiment of liberation; Fond of the lasya dance; cause of dissolution; modesty; adored by Rambha and the other celestial dancers.

verses.devanagari: भवदाव सुधाव्ड़्ष्टिः पापारण्य दवानला । दौर्भाग्यतूल वातूला जराध्वान्त रविप्रभा ॥ १४३ ॥
verses.iast: bhavadāva sudhāvṛṣṭiḥ, pāpāraṇya davānalā । daurbhāgyatūla vātūlā, jarādhvānta raviprabhā ॥ 143 ॥
verses.meaning: A rain of nectar on the forest fire of worldly existence; a wildfire to the forest of sins; A whirlwind that scatters the cotton of misfortune; sunlight that dispels the darkness of old age.

verses.devanagari: भाग्याब्धिचन्द्रिका भक्तचित्तकेकि घनाघना । रोगपर्वत दम्भोळि र्म्ड़्त्युदारु कुठारिका ॥ १४४ ॥
verses.iast: bhāgyābdhichandrikā, bhaktachittakēki ghanāghanā । rōgaparvata dambhōḻi, rmṛtyudāru kuṭhārikā ॥ 144 ॥
verses.meaning: Moonlight on the ocean of good fortune; a rain-cloud to the peacock-like minds of devotees; A thunderbolt to the mountain of disease; an axe to the tree of death.

verses.devanagari: महेश्वरी महाकाळी महाग्रासा महाऽशना । अपर्णा चण्डिका चण्डमुण्डाऽसुर निषूदिनी ॥ १४५ ॥
verses.iast: mahēśvarī, mahākāḻī, mahāgrāsā, mahā'śanā । aparṇā, chaṇḍikā, chaṇḍamuṇḍā'sura niṣūdinī ॥ 145 ॥
verses.meaning: The great ruler (Maheshvari); Mahakali; the great devourer; the great consumer of all; Aparna (who did not even eat leaves in her penance); Chandika; slayer of the demons Chanda and Munda.

verses.devanagari: क्षराक्षरात्मिका सर्वलोकेशी विश्वधारिणी । त्रिवर्गदात्री सुभगा त्र्यम्बका त्रिगुणात्मिका ॥ १४६ ॥
verses.iast: kṣarākṣarātmikā, sarvalōkēśī, viśvadhāriṇī । trivargadātrī, subhagā, tryambakā, triguṇātmikā ॥ 146 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose nature is both the perishable and the imperishable; ruler of all worlds; supporter of the universe; Giver of the three goals of life; the graceful one; the three-eyed; embodiment of the three gunas.

verses.devanagari: स्वर्गापवर्गदा शुद्धा जपापुष्प निभाक्ड़्तिः । ओजोवती द्युतिधरा यज्ञरूपा प्रियव्रता ॥ १४७ ॥
verses.iast: svargāpavargadā, śuddhā, japāpuṣpa nibhākṛtiḥ । ōjōvatī, dyutidharā, yajñarūpā, priyavratā ॥ 147 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of heaven and liberation; pure; radiant like the hibiscus flower; Full of vitality (ojas); bearer of light; whose form is sacrifice; fond of sacred vows.

verses.devanagari: दुराराध्या दुरादर्षा पाटली कुसुमप्रिया । महती मेरुनिलया मन्दार कुसुमप्रिया ॥ १४८ ॥
verses.iast: durārādhyā, durādarṣā, pāṭalī kusumapriyā । mahatī, mērunilayā, mandāra kusumapriyā ॥ 148 ॥
verses.meaning: Hard to worship; hard to overpower; fond of patali flowers; The great one (Mahati); dwelling on Mount Meru; fond of mandara flowers.

verses.devanagari: वीराराध्या विराड्रूपा विरजा विश्वतोमुखी । प्रत्यग्रूपा पराकाशा प्राणदा प्राणरूपिणी ॥ १४९ ॥
verses.iast: vīrārādhyā, virāḍrūpā, virajā, viśvatōmukhī । pratyagrūpā, parākāśā, prāṇadā, prāṇarūpiṇī ॥ 149 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped by heroes; whose form is the cosmos (Virat); pure (free of rajas); facing all sides; Whose form is the inner Self; the supreme space; giver of life; whose form is life.

verses.devanagari: मार्ताण्ड भैरवाराध्या मन्त्रिणी न्यस्तराज्यधूः । त्रिपुरेशी जयत्सेना निस्त्रैगुण्या परापरा ॥ १५० ॥
verses.iast: mārtāṇḍa bhairavārādhyā, mantriṇī nyastarājyadhūḥ । tripurēśī, jayatsēnā, nistraiguṇyā, parāparā ॥ 150 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped by Martanda Bhairava; who entrusted the burdens of rule to Mantrini; Ruler of Tripura; with a victorious army; beyond the three gunas; both supreme and lower.

verses.devanagari: सत्यज्ञानाऽनन्दरूपा सामरस्य परायणा । कपर्दिनी कलामाला कामधुक्कामरूपिणी ॥ १५१ ॥
verses.iast: satyajñānā'nandarūpā, sāmarasya parāyaṇā । kapardinī, kalāmālā, kāmadhuk,kāmarūpiṇī ॥ 151 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose form is truth, knowledge and bliss; devoted to the state of oneness (samarasya); Consort of Kapardin (Shiva); garlanded with the arts; who yields all desires (Kamadhenu); who takes any form at will.

verses.devanagari: कळानिधिः काव्यकळा रसज्ञा रसशेवधिः । पुष्टा पुरातना पूज्या पुष्करा पुष्करेक्षणा ॥ १५२ ॥
verses.iast: kaḻānidhiḥ, kāvyakaḻā, rasajñā, rasaśēvadhiḥ । puṣṭā, purātanā, pūjyā, puṣkarā, puṣkarēkṣaṇā ॥ 152 ॥
verses.meaning: Treasure of the arts; the art of poetry; knower of rasa (essence); treasury of rasa; Full and nourished; the ancient one; worthy of worship; the nourisher (Pushkara); lotus-eyed.

verses.devanagari: परञ्ज्योतिः परन्धाम परमाणुः परात्परा । पाशहस्ता पाशहन्त्री परमन्त्र विभेदिनी ॥ १५३ ॥
verses.iast: parañjyōtiḥ, parandhāma, paramāṇuḥ, parātparā । pāśahastā, pāśahantrī, paramantra vibhēdinī ॥ 153 ॥
verses.meaning: The supreme light; the supreme abode; the subtlest atom; higher than the highest; Holding the noose in her hand; destroyer of bonds; who breaks the spells of enemies.

verses.devanagari: मूर्ताऽमूर्ताऽनित्यत्ड़्प्ता मुनि मानस हंसिका । सत्यव्रता सत्यरूपा सर्वान्तर्यामिनी सती ॥ १५४ ॥
verses.iast: mūrtā,'mūrtā,'nityatṛptā, muni mānasa haṃsikā । satyavratā, satyarūpā, sarvāntaryāminī, satī ॥ 154 ॥
verses.meaning: With form; formless; pleased even with passing offerings; the swan in the minds of sages; Devoted to truth; whose form is truth; the inner controller of all; Sati.

verses.devanagari: ब्रह्माणी ब्रह्मजननी बहुरूपा बुधार्चिता । प्रसवित्री प्रचण्डाऽज्ञा प्रतिष्ठा प्रकटाक्ड़्तिः ॥ १५५ ॥
verses.iast: brahmāṇī, brahmajananī, bahurūpā, budhārchitā । prasavitrī, prachaṇḍā'jñā, pratiṣṭhā, prakaṭākṛtiḥ ॥ 155 ॥
verses.meaning: Brahmani; mother of Brahma; of many forms; worshipped by the wise; Who gives birth to all; the Fierce; the Command (Ajna); the foundation (Pratishtha); manifest in form.

verses.devanagari: प्राणेश्वरी प्राणदात्री पञ्चाशत्पीठरूपिणी । विश्ड़्ङ्खला विविक्तस्था वीरमाता वियत्प्रसूः ॥ १५६ ॥
verses.iast: prāṇēśvarī, prāṇadātrī, pañchāśat-pīṭharūpiṇī । viśṛṅkhalā, viviktasthā, vīramātā, viyatprasūḥ ॥ 156 ॥
verses.meaning: Ruler of the life-breath; giver of life; whose form is the fifty sacred seats (pithas); Unfettered; dwelling in solitude; mother of heroes; mother of space.

verses.devanagari: मुकुन्दा मुक्ति निलया मूलविग्रह रूपिणी । भावज्ञा भवरोगघ्नी भवचक्र प्रवर्तिनी ॥ १५७ ॥
verses.iast: mukundā, mukti nilayā, mūlavigraha rūpiṇī । bhāvajñā, bhavarōgaghnī bhavachakra pravartinī ॥ 157 ॥
verses.meaning: Mukunda (giver of liberation); abode of liberation; whose form is the original image; Knower of all feelings; destroyer of the disease of worldly existence; who turns the wheel of births.

verses.devanagari: छन्दस्सारा शास्त्रसारा मन्त्रसारा तलोदरी । उदारकीर्ति रुद्दामवैभवा वर्णरूपिणी ॥ १५८ ॥
verses.iast: Chandassārā, śāstrasārā, mantrasārā, talōdarī । udārakīrti, ruddāmavaibhavā, varṇarūpiṇī ॥ 158 ॥
verses.meaning: Essence of the Vedic metres; essence of the scriptures; essence of the mantras; slender-waisted; Of noble fame; of boundless glory; whose form is the letters (varnas).

verses.devanagari: जन्मम्ड़्त्यु जरातप्त जन विश्रान्ति दायिनी । सर्वोपनिष दुद्घुष्टा शान्त्यतीत कळात्मिका ॥ १५९ ॥
verses.iast: janmamṛtyu jarātapta jana viśrānti dāyinī । sarvōpaniṣa dudghuṣṭā, śāntyatīta kaḻātmikā ॥ 159 ॥
verses.meaning: Giver of rest to people scorched by birth, death and old age; Proclaimed by all the Upanishads; whose nature is the state beyond peace (Shantyatita kala).

verses.devanagari: गम्भीरा गगनान्तःस्था गर्विता गानलोलुपा । कल्पनारहिता काष्ठा कान्ता कान्तार्ध विग्रहा ॥ १६० ॥
verses.iast: gambhīrā, gaganāntaḥsthā, garvitā, gānalōlupā । kalpanārahitā, kāṣṭhā, kāntā, kāntārdha vigrahā ॥ 160 ॥
verses.meaning: Profound; dwelling within space; proud; fond of music; Free of mental constructs; the goal (Kashtha); the beloved; whose body is half of her beloved (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: कार्यकारण निर्मुक्ता कामकेळि तरङ्गिता । कनत्कनकताटङ्का लीलाविग्रह धारिणी ॥ १६१ ॥
verses.iast: kāryakāraṇa nirmuktā, kāmakēḻi taraṅgitā । kanat-kanakatāṭaṅkā, līlāvigraha dhāriṇī ॥ 161 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of cause and effect; rippling with the waves of Kameshvara's love-play; With shining golden earrings; who takes on forms in play.

verses.devanagari: अजाक्षय विनिर्मुक्ता मुग्धा क्षिप्रप्रसादिनी । अन्तर्मुख समाराध्या बहिर्मुख सुदुर्लभा ॥ १६२ ॥
verses.iast: ajākṣaya vinirmuktā, mugdhā kṣipraprasādinī । antarmukha samārādhyā, bahirmukha sudurlabhā ॥ 162 ॥
verses.meaning: Free of birth and decay; the innocent one; quick to grant grace; Worshipped by those who turn inward; very hard to reach for those who turn outward.

verses.devanagari: त्रयी त्रिवर्ग निलया त्रिस्था त्रिपुरमालिनी । निरामया निरालम्बा स्वात्मारामा सुधास्ड़्तिः ॥ १६३ ॥
verses.iast: trayī, trivarga nilayā, tristhā, tripuramālinī । nirāmayā, nirālambā, svātmārāmā, sudhāsṛtiḥ ॥ 163 ॥
verses.meaning: The three Vedas; abode of the three goals of life; dwelling in the three worlds; wearing the garland of Tripura; Free of disease; without support; rejoicing in her own Self; a stream of nectar.

verses.devanagari: संसारपङ्क निर्मग्न समुद्धरण पण्डिता । यज्ञप्रिया यज्ञकर्त्री यजमान स्वरूपिणी ॥ १६४ ॥
verses.iast: saṃsārapaṅka nirmagna samuddharaṇa paṇḍitā । yajñapriyā, yajñakartrī, yajamāna svarūpiṇī ॥ 164 ॥
verses.meaning: Skilled in lifting out those sunk in the mire of worldly existence; Fond of sacrifices; performer of sacrifices; who is herself the one who sacrifices.

verses.devanagari: धर्माधारा धनाध्यक्षा धनधान्य विवर्धिनी । विप्रप्रिया विप्ररूपा विश्वभ्रमण कारिणी ॥ १६५ ॥
verses.iast: dharmādhārā, dhanādhyakṣā, dhanadhānya vivardhinī । viprapriyā, viprarūpā, viśvabhramaṇa kāriṇī ॥ 165 ॥
verses.meaning: Support of dharma; overseer of wealth; increaser of wealth and grain; Fond of the learned; whose form is the learned; who makes the universe revolve.

verses.devanagari: विश्वग्रासा विद्रुमाभा वैष्णवी विष्णुरूपिणी । अयोनि र्योनिनिलया कूटस्था कुलरूपिणी ॥ १६६ ॥
verses.iast: viśvagrāsā, vidrumābhā, vaiṣṇavī, viṣṇurūpiṇī । ayōni, ryōninilayā, kūṭasthā, kularūpiṇī ॥ 166 ॥
verses.meaning: Who devours the universe at dissolution; coral-red in colour; Vaishnavi; whose form is Vishnu; Without origin; dwelling in the source (yoni); unchanging (Kutastha); whose form is Kula.

verses.devanagari: वीरगोष्ठीप्रिया वीरा नैष्कर्म्या नादरूपिणी । विज्ञान कलना कल्या विदग्धा बैन्दवासना ॥ १६७ ॥
verses.iast: vīragōṣṭhīpriyā, vīrā, naiṣkarmyā, nādarūpiṇī । vijñāna kalanā, kalyā vidagdhā, baindavāsanā ॥ 167 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of the assembly of heroes; the heroic one; beyond action; whose form is sound (nada); The working of wisdom; the capable one; the expert; seated in the bindu.

verses.devanagari: तत्त्वाधिका तत्त्वमयी तत्त्वमर्थ स्वरूपिणी । सामगानप्रिया सौम्या सदाशिव कुटुम्बिनी ॥ १६८ ॥
verses.iast: tattvādhikā, tattvamayī, tattvamartha svarūpiṇī । sāmagānapriyā, saumyā, sadāśiva kuṭumbinī ॥ 168 ॥
verses.meaning: Transcending the tattvas; made of the tattvas; whose nature is the meaning of 'Tat Tvam' (That thou art); Fond of Sama Veda chanting; gentle; wife of Sadashiva.

verses.devanagari: सव्यापसव्य मार्गस्था सर्वापद्वि निवारिणी । स्वस्था स्वभावमधुरा धीरा धीर समर्चिता ॥ १६९ ॥
verses.iast: savyāpasavya mārgasthā, sarvāpadvi nivāriṇī । svasthā, svabhāvamadhurā, dhīrā, dhīra samarchitā ॥ 169 ॥
verses.meaning: Who follows both the right and the left paths of worship; who wards off all calamities; Abiding in herself; naturally sweet; courageous; worshipped by the wise.

verses.devanagari: चैतन्यार्घ्य समाराध्या चैतन्य कुसुमप्रिया । सदोदिता सदातुष्टा तरुणादित्य पाटला ॥ १७० ॥
verses.iast: chaitanyārghya samārādhyā, chaitanya kusumapriyā । sadōditā, sadātuṣṭā, taruṇāditya pāṭalā ॥ 170 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped with the offering of consciousness; fond of the flower of consciousness; Ever-rising; ever content; rosy like the rising sun.

verses.devanagari: दक्षिणा दक्षिणाराध्या दरस्मेर मुखाम्बुजा । कौळिनी केवलाऽनर्घ्या कैवल्य पददायिनी ॥ १७१ ॥
verses.iast: dakṣiṇā, dakṣiṇārādhyā, darasmēra mukhāmbujā । kauḻinī kēvalā,'narghyā kaivalya padadāyinī ॥ 171 ॥
verses.meaning: Dakshina (the gracious); worshipped by the learned and the simple alike; with a lotus face lit by a gentle smile; Kaulini; the Absolute (Kevala); priceless; giver of the state of liberation (kaivalya).

verses.devanagari: स्तोत्रप्रिया स्तुतिमती श्रुतिसंस्तुत वैभवा । मनस्विनी मानवती महेशी मङ्गळाक्ड़्तिः ॥ १७२ ॥
verses.iast: stōtrapriyā, stutimatī, śrutisaṃstuta vaibhavā । manasvinī, mānavatī, mahēśī, maṅgaḻākṛtiḥ ॥ 172 ॥
verses.meaning: Fond of hymns; worthy of praise; whose glory is praised by the Vedas; Of noble mind; full of dignity; the great ruler; of auspicious form.

verses.devanagari: विश्वमाता जगद्धात्री विशालाक्षी विरागिणी । प्रगल्भा परमोदारा परामोदा मनोमयी ॥ १७३ ॥
verses.iast: viśvamātā, jagaddhātrī, viśālākṣī, virāgiṇī। pragalbhā, paramōdārā, parāmōdā, manōmayī ॥ 173 ॥
verses.meaning: Mother of the universe; sustainer of the world; large-eyed; free of attachment; Bold; supremely generous; supreme joy; whose nature is the mind.

verses.devanagari: व्योमकेशी विमानस्था वज्रिणी वामकेश्वरी । पञ्चयज्ञप्रिया पञ्चप्रेत मञ्चाधिशायिनी ॥ १७४ ॥
verses.iast: vyōmakēśī, vimānasthā, vajriṇī, vāmakēśvarī । pañchayajñapriyā, pañchaprēta mañchādhiśāyinī ॥ 174 ॥
verses.meaning: Whose hair is the sky; dwelling in the celestial chariot; holder of the thunderbolt; consort of Vamakeshvara; Fond of the five daily sacrifices; reclining on the couch made of the five corpses.

verses.devanagari: पञ्चमी पञ्चभूतेशी पञ्च सङ्ख्योपचारिणी । शाश्वती शाश्वतैश्वर्या शर्मदा शम्भुमोहिनी ॥ १७५ ॥
verses.iast: pañchamī, pañchabhūtēśī, pañcha saṅkhyōpachāriṇī । śāśvatī, śāśvataiśvaryā, śarmadā, śambhumōhinī ॥ 175 ॥
verses.meaning: The fifth (Panchami); ruler of the five elements; worshipped with the five offerings; Eternal; of eternal sovereignty; giver of happiness; enchantress of Shambhu (Shiva).

verses.devanagari: धरा धरसुता धन्या धर्मिणी धर्मवर्धिनी । लोकातीता गुणातीता सर्वातीता शमात्मिका ॥ १७६ ॥
verses.iast: dharā, dharasutā, dhanyā, dharmiṇī, dharmavardhinī । lōkātītā, guṇātītā, sarvātītā, śamātmikā ॥ 176 ॥
verses.meaning: The Earth (Dhara); daughter of the mountain; blessed; righteous; increaser of dharma; Beyond the worlds; beyond the gunas; beyond everything; whose nature is peace.

verses.devanagari: बन्धूक कुसुम प्रख्या बाला लीलाविनोदिनी । सुमङ्गळी सुखकरी सुवेषाड्या सुवासिनी ॥ १७७ ॥
verses.iast: bandhūka kusuma prakhyā, bālā, līlāvinōdinī । sumaṅgaḻī, sukhakarī, suvēṣāḍyā, suvāsinī ॥ 177 ॥
verses.meaning: Radiant like the bandhuka flower; the young girl (Bala); who delights in play; Wholly auspicious (Sumangali); giver of happiness; beautifully dressed; the auspicious married woman (Suvasini).

verses.devanagari: सुवासिन्यर्चनप्रीता शोभना शुद्ध मानसा । बिन्दु तर्पण सन्तुष्टा पूर्वजा त्रिपुराम्बिका ॥ १७८ ॥
verses.iast: suvāsinyarchanaprītā, śōbhanā, śuddha mānasā । bindu tarpaṇa santuṣṭā, pūrvajā, tripurāmbikā ॥ 178 ॥
verses.meaning: Pleased by the worship of suvasinis (married women); radiant; pure-minded; Pleased by offerings into the bindu; the first-born; Tripurambika.

verses.devanagari: दशमुद्रा समाराध्या त्रिपुरा श्रीवशङ्करी । ज्ञानमुद्रा ज्ञानगम्या ज्ञानज्ञेय स्वरूपिणी ॥ १७९ ॥
verses.iast: daśamudrā samārādhyā, tripurā śrīvaśaṅkarī । jñānamudrā, jñānagamyā, jñānajñēya svarūpiṇī ॥ 179 ॥
verses.meaning: Worshipped through the ten mudras; Tripurashri, who brings all under her sway; The jnana-mudra; reached through knowledge; whose form is both knowledge and the known.

verses.devanagari: योनिमुद्रा त्रिखण्डेशी त्रिगुणाम्बा त्रिकोणगा । अनघाद्भुत चारित्रा वाञ्छितार्थ प्रदायिनी ॥ १८० ॥
verses.iast: yōnimudrā, trikhaṇḍēśī, triguṇāmbā, trikōṇagā । anaghādbhuta chāritrā, vāñChitārtha pradāyinī ॥ 180 ॥
verses.meaning: The yoni-mudra; ruler of the three sections (Trikhanda); mother of the three gunas; dwelling in the triangle; Of sinless and wondrous deeds; giver of all that is desired.

verses.devanagari: अभ्यासाति शयज्ञाता षडध्वातीत रूपिणी । अव्याज करुणामूर्ति रज्ञानध्वान्त दीपिका ॥ १८१ ॥
verses.iast: abhyāsāti śayajñātā, ṣaḍadhvātīta rūpiṇī । avyāja karuṇāmūrti, rajñānadhvānta dīpikā ॥ 181 ॥
verses.meaning: Known through intense, repeated practice; whose form transcends the six paths (adhvas); Embodiment of compassion without any motive; the lamp that dispels the darkness of ignorance.

verses.devanagari: आबालगोप विदिता सर्वानुल्लङ्घ्य शासना । श्री चक्रराजनिलया श्रीमत्त्रिपुर सुन्दरी ॥ १८२ ॥
verses.iast: ābālagōpa viditā, sarvānullaṅghya śāsanā । śrī chakrarājanilayā, śrīmattripura sundarī ॥ 182 ॥
verses.meaning: Known to all, even children and cowherds; whose command no one can disobey; Dwelling in the Sri Chakra; the glorious Tripura Sundari.

verses.devanagari: श्री शिवा शिवशक्त्यैक्य रूपिणी ललिताम्बिका । एवं श्रीललितादेव्या नाम्नां साहस्रकं जगुः ॥ १८३ ॥
verses.iast: śrī śivā, śivaśaktyaikya rūpiṇī, lalitāmbikā । ēvaṃ śrīlalitādēvyā nāmnāṃ sāhasrakaṃ jaguḥ ॥ 183 ॥
verses.meaning: Sri Shiva (the Auspicious One); whose form is the union of Shiva and Shakti; Lalitambika (Mother Lalita). Thus did they sing the thousand names of Sri Lalita Devi.

verses.devanagari: ॥ श्री ललिताम्बिकायै नमः ॥
